title: Macro transmission seed
scope: US and Indian monetary-policy pathways, plus oil-to-gasoline costs. A small structural map, not comprehensive global macro coverage.
license: MIT — original topology and summaries only; linked sources retain their own terms
limitations: Structural research starting point; no current prices, financial statements or live alerts.
Source review date is not an observation date or proof of current relationship validity.
Documented means supported by the cited source in its stated context, not independently audited or predictive.
Hypotheses require additional evidence; they must not be promoted automatically.

edges.mechanism: The Fed uses its policy-rate tools to influence financial conditions.
edges.research_question: What changed in the latest policy decision and guidance?

edges.mechanism: Policy-rate changes can transmit to household and business borrowing costs.
edges.research_question: Have actual financing costs moved with the policy stance?

edges.mechanism: Borrowing costs influence household spending decisions, alongside other factors.
edges.research_question: Is spending responding, and over what lag?

edges.mechanism: Financing conditions affect firms' incentives to invest.
edges.research_question: Do investment plans confirm the proposed financing channel?

edges.mechanism: Demand changes can affect inflation; the sign and size depend on supply and other conditions.
edges.research_question: Is the observed inflation change demand-driven?

edges.mechanism: Crude oil costs contribute to gasoline prices, alongside refining, distribution and taxes.
edges.research_question: How much of an oil move has reached pump prices?

edges.mechanism: A fuel-cost change may alter household spending elsewhere; this pack does not establish its size.
edges.research_question: Is there household-level evidence of a spending substitution?

edges.mechanism: The repo rate is a monetary-policy instrument of the RBI framework.
edges.research_question: What is the latest published decision, rather than the last cached rate?

edges.mechanism: Repo-linked lending can transmit policy changes; other benchmarks and reset terms also matter.
edges.research_question: Which loans are repo-linked and when do they reset?
